text:
amanda: Quick question — thinking about adding richer audit fields for autofallback decisions. We should surface WHY we fell back and the policy snapshot that triggered it in the console. Anyone 👀?

mike: +1. what fields are you thinking? retention?

sophie: We currently log a tiny enum: fallback_code, but it's useless. I'd like fallback_reason (string), policy_id, policy_version, decision_trace_id (uuid), sampled_evidence (small JSON blob). Also include model_variant fallback_to and latency_at_trigger_ms.

raj: Agree. For retention, legal asked for 90 days default. Ops will ask for 365 for incident investigations. Maybe make retention configurable per-org/route.

elaine: UI Q — do we show the full blob inline in the console or condensed with a link to playback? I'd prefer condensed + expand to avoid noise.

amanda: Prototype payload: 
```json
{
  "fallback_reason":"latency_threshold_exceeded",
  "policy_id":"contingency-v3",
  "policy_version":"2026-02-18T10:23Z",
  "decision_trace_id":"a1b2c3d4",
  "latency_ms":1250,
  "target_model":"redwood-7b-quant",
  "fallback_model":"redwood-3b",
  "sampled_kv":"{\"prompt_prefix\":true}"
}
```

mike: love it. add error_class too (model_error, infra_error, rate_limit).

ops-bot: NOTE: retention override requires legal signoff. :robot_face:

sophie: Also need sampling policy — we can't log full request bodies for PII. Add sampled_request_hash and allow opt-out via route config.

raj: API surface: internal admin API to fetch decision traces by decision_trace_id. Also want a webhook to stream sampled traces to SIEM for customers that opt in.

amanda: UX flows I'm thinking: 1) inline card in route run details with short reason + link; 2) playback page that reconstructs request/response w/ timeline; 3) audit export endpoint for investigations.

elaine: For console, show policy_version with a diff link to compare the snapshot at time-of-decision. Small badge for "automated fallback" and a dropdown for evidence.

mike: tech note: compress sampled_evidence and cap at 10KB. sign fields with HMAC to detect tampering.

sophie: security: mask any auth headers, redact PII fields. we'll push a redaction schema and a test harness.

amanda: ok action items: @mike implement logging schema + hmac; @sophie sampling/redaction rules; @raj admin-api + webhook; @elaine UX mockups for inline card + playback; i'll draft retention defaults and policy.

raj: timeline? next sprint?

mike: i can take logging schema this sprint, admin-api next.

elaine: mockups by Wed.

amanda: sweet. thanks all. :pray:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: infra-deploy: autofallback-audit-schema v1 deployed to staging at 1719995488

mike: verified logs look good in staging. sample entry: {"decision_trace_id":"a1b2c3d4","fallback_reason":"latency_threshold_exceeded"} — will push PR soon.
